title: Reference study of IFC software support: the GeoBIM benchmark 2019 — Part I
reasoning: The paper is a technical benchmark of software for Industry Foundation Classes (IFC) and GeoBIM integration. It evaluates software performance, data interoperability, and standards compliance in the architecture, engineering, and construction (AEC) and geospatial domains. The content does not touch upon topics of religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
